|game_text=Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacity (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-02-Rebel_Aces.png]] and [[:File:VB7-p8-47-I_ll_Take_The_Leader.png]], slip 45) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-rebelaces-pre.gif]]). The later errata version is [[Rebel Aces (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010, slip 45; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacity (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 46)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Rebel Aces (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Aces (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) spells “astromech capacit” (typo as published). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1271_45">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on table. Your [[Sandwhirl]] is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ [[Close Air Support]]. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacit (except ''Falcon'' or [[Artoo-Detoo In Red 5]]) gain "May add 1 astromech."” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list writes the quotation in single quotes (its HTML cannot hold double quotes); the printed double quotes are kept.
